source.name: Pressing Tab in an open date field must move focus to the next form field
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/mymth/vanillajs-datepicker/issues/156) at 6156648a4cbcb662d4e1f5f4b449adf0f9a67759. Blind to the maintainers' fix 1533350d5ea7d790ea36fcdaf4bcbfd170ddcfab; routing auto.

journey.title: Tab out of the visit date into the access notes
journey.goal: Pressing Tab in the open date field moves focus to the next form field so the user can keep typing

functionalJourney.title: Pick a visit date with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a day in the calendar fills the visit date field

guards.title: Pick the next day with arrow keys
guards.goal: Arrow keys move the calendar focus and Enter commits the date

plan.root_cause: The datepicker's keydown listener prevents the default action of the Tab key when the picker is open, trapping focus inside the picker and preventing movement to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the keydown listener to allow Tab to close the picker and proceed with default focus traversal when the picker is active, while preserving other keyboard navigation.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Tab while the date picker is open will close the picker and move focus to the next focusable element (the notes input), enabling keyboard users to navigate the form without getting trapped.
functional_risks: Users who rely on Tab to navigate within the date picker (e.g., between prev/view/next buttons) will need to use arrow keys or other provided controls instead.
The change is low risk because the date picker already provides arrow keys and Enter for date selection, and Tab navigation inside the picker is not essential.
verification_requirements: Tab from the visit-date input moves focus to the notes input when the picker is open.
Arrow keys still change the focused date within the picker.
Enter still selects the focused date when the picker is open.
Escape or clicking outside the picker still closes it.
Form submission continues to work correctly.
